name: Multi-input MLP (mi-MLP)
definition: A network structure that incorporates the inputs (3D location and viewing direction) of the vanilla MLP into each layer to prevent overfitting in few-shot view synthesis without harming detailed synthesis.
summary: The multi-input MLP (mi-MLP) is a NeRF architecture that incorporates positional encoding into every layer to prevent overfitting in few-shot view synthesis while maintaining high-frequency detail capacity.
